name: git-delivery
description: Report the pushed job branch as the delivery.
script:
set -eu
ref="refs/heads/$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH"
remote=$(git --git-dir="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPODIR" ls-remote --refs origin "$ref")
if [ -z "$PECORE_JOB_COMMIT" ] || [ "${remote%%[[:space:]]*}" != "$PECORE_JOB_COMMIT" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Remote branch $PECORE_JOB_BRANCH does not point to the job commit." >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH"
